sentences.en: You have tennis elbow. Soak your arm in warm water.
sentences.zh: 你患了网球肘。用温水泡泡手臂。

sentences.en: I used to play tennis when I was a student.
sentences.zh: 我学生时代经常打网球。

sentences.en: The rain prevented us from finishing our game of tennis.
sentences.zh: 下雨让我们没能完成网球比赛。
